baseline: Last creator-confirmed relevant successful prompt and outcome, exact model/device/fields where known; missing baseline = OPEN, never fabricate

checks.criterion: Stabiler physischer Kern, rollende Bewegung wenn beabsichtigt
Bewährte Suno-Sprache, keine stille Kürzung, bestätigte Geräteprofile
Keine ungewollte Genre-, Tempo- oder Strukturvorgabe

decisions.PASS: All applicable protections maintained, relevant improvement evidenced, explicit creator approval; track-local only
decisions.HOLD: Missing evidence, mixed or uncertain result; retain baseline
decisions.FAIL: Unrequested regression; retain baseline and isolate candidate

static_cases: No silent truncation; explicit rephrasing and field budget review
Do not infer tempo from duration
No fixed genre or BPM override
Preserve lyrics and terminal vocal guard when requested
No unverified DSP or neurological claims
No new provider fields without evidence
